messages:
Sara: Quick sync — proposing a Capacity Funnel playbook to manage incoming product requests (customer asks, platform work, infra reliability). TL;DR: guaranteed team slots + floating pool + RICE for large asks. thoughts?
Leo: Quick q — how do slots map to teams? fixed monthly quotas or a rolling pool?
Sara: Thinking per-quarter: each core product team gets 3 guaranteed dev-weeks (slots) + 2 floating slots they can trade. Floating pool triaged weekly by product leads. Anything >8w moves to formal RICE review.
Mina: Concern: floating pool might starve infra/ops. We should reserve at least 1 infra-specific slot per quarter and an emergency buffer. :warning:
Jess: Could we standardize ticket metadata to make triage easier? e.g. `slot_type: guaranteed|floating|infra`, `effort_est: S|M|L`, `customer_impact: L|M|H`
Oliver: Also add a metric for queue_wait_time so we can measure time-to-action per request type. helps quantify backlog cost.
Leo: I prefer deterministic capacity for planning. RICE tends to vary by rater. Can we use calibrated scoring (guidelines + median) so it's less noisy?
Ashley: For ML-heavy asks, effort is dominated by eval/regression safety. We should tag `ml-heavy` so those use a separate quota or exemption.
Sara: Good call. For launch criteria I want a minimal checklist: 1) perf budget reviewed, 2) e2e smoke tests pass, 3) rollout + rollback plan, 4) monitoring/alerts defined. Objections?
Mina: +1. Also add a monitoring playbook entry with alert thresholds and runbook links.
Jess: :thumbsup: Product Ops can draft a triage + slot-request template and PR it to the docs repo. I'll own the initial draft.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot pinned a message: "Capacity Funnel draft v0.1 added to /docs/triage/"
Sara: I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri to finalize details. @Leo @Mina please bring 2 recent requests and we'll slot them into the funnel as examples. Thanks all.
